Install Burrow

Free and MIT licensed, on as many machines as you like. No account, no trial, no subscription.

Homebrew

Installs the Developer ID signed, Apple-notarized app with its engine bundled. Quarantine is preserved so Gatekeeper can validate the ticket.

# app + bundled engine brew install --cask caezium/tap/burrow

Direct download

The notarized zip from GitHub releases. Unzip into /Applications and keep quarantine intact so Gatekeeper can verify the ticket.

Download Burrow 0.11.2 for macOS

Universal, 22 MB zip. All releases

Windows (beta)

A native WinUI 3 and .NET 8 build, reaching parity tool by tool. It ships as a zip with the conductor and engine bundled; an installer is coming.

Download BurrowWin 0.10.0 for x64

The Windows build trails the Mac release; 0.10.0 is the latest preview.

Build from source

Needs xcodegen. Produces a locally ad-hoc signed build with checksum-pinned frameworks.

git clone https://github.com/caezium/Burrow.git cd Burrow bash scripts/release.sh
RequirementsmacOS 14 or later, on Apple Silicon and Intel. Windows 10 and 11 for the preview build.
UpdatesIn-app updates are signed and delivered over Sparkle. Homebrew installs update with brew upgrade.
UninstallingDrag Burrow to the Trash, or brew uninstall --cask burrow. No background agents are left behind.
